page.content:
Civic valley between Palatine and Capitoline.

How Roman Forum connects

  • Location: Rome — The Forum sits in the civic heart of Rome.
  • Work: Twelve Tables — The Twelve Tables were displayed in the Forum.
  • Event: Assassination of Caesar — Caesar's funeral in the Forum turned the city against the Liberators.

What is Roman Forum?

The Forum Romanum was the Republic's open-air machine: Rostra, Curia, basilicas, and the path of triumphs. Speeches and funerals there could move the city.

Key threads lead to Rome, Twelve Tables and Assassination of Caesar.
